name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — Milestone 1 complete at v0.5.0: `help`, `init`, `overview`, `function` and `status` work; the other ten commands are declared-not-built and labelled as such in commands/help.md, so invoking one produces nothing rather than a guess. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. `status` is the loop exit condition and is deterministic by construction — it refuses to return 0 while any artifact is stale or any question with a non-empty blocks[] is open, because a green light that is not true is worse than a red one, and it always names the next command even when the answer is that a person must decide. Reads req through scripts/req-contract.mjs, the single place that knows the shape of req output, and halts with exit 2 naming the path it looked for rather than inferring a missing input. Business rules are REFERENCED as req BR-xxx@vN, never re-minted, because two ids for one rule drift apart the moment /req:change moves a version. The trace graph is derived from the artifacts rather than hand-written, split by author so a regeneration cannot eat another plugin edges. Generated documents are never hand-edited and carry no edit-here markers; every command is idempotent, halts when a preceding step is not done, and writes nothing without --write.
